project.name: IIOP baseline for the ORB over HTTP work
project.description:
A remote EJB, and a client that invokes it over IIOP against a real GlassFish. It exists to measure what a remote view actually carries today, rather than asserting it - the HTTP transport claims to reproduce this behaviour, and a claim of equivalence is worth no more than the description of the thing being equalled.
Not part of the pull request. This is our own harness.
